coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 8 ground-truth variable items (25%): both child-to-parent and parent-to-child query directions, and retrieval accuracy measured by correct-answer proportions.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed top-1000 IMDb/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata/Wikipedia pairs. Omits the specified GPT-3.5-turbo and Llama model comparison and chat-versus-completion interaction modes. Although temperatures 0 and 1 are included, they are assigned by experimental arm rather than model type or in-context demonstration setting. Uses McNemar and Wilcoxon instead of t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests. A pinned grading protocol does not establish the specified constant set of dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected higher child-to-parent retrieval performance and significantly lower parent-to-child performance confirming the reversal curse.
